reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: They refused to return my money
reports.description: The website  bitexchangers.live had a video ad on  coinpayu.com which started that I could buy high rate ETH from their website in exchange for btc. I pay 0.005 BTC and I receive 0.36 ETH. This operation takes less than 10 minutes.That was about 4 weeks ago on 22 March 2022. Yet, There was a strange command button which asked me to receive 0.9 ETH if I paid just 0.005 btc more, so I followed their Instruction. When done, the same button appeared asking me to double my deposite and receive 1.8 ETH. This time I refused and chose the other button. Then a new order appeared asking me to pay fees as follows:  pay at least 0.00294 BTC to the following address and receive 0.9 ETH after 24 hours, or pay 0.00371 and receive your 0.9 ETH within one hour, or pay 0.00397 BTC and receive 0.9 ETH within 10 minutes. This is the address I should have sent funds to.3EGvWCJ4H967rqPMDoFZKPXT92939YCAvR. I contacted the company through the live chat box and expressed my surprise about the hidden fees which are not normal. The person who answered me on the chat box through writing that if I did not pay the fees within 3 days, they would cancel the operation and return my money. Since then, they have not returned my money which is in total 0.01 BTC. They have a proton email which is invalid now. Their website is unreachable unless I hide my ip address or use unnkown device to them. They also run the website under 2 different names : bitexchangers.live and bitexchangers.top I believe they use more than one wallet address.
